title: Prompt Studio and durable lifecycle
outcome: Deliver protected encrypted prompt variants and a complete encrypted session lifecycle with explicit crash recovery, Settings-only History, safe individual export, and isolated deletion.

workPackages.title: Prompt Studio
mutableTargets: prompt composition and session snapshot integration

protectedInvariants: templates cannot alter typed response schemas, mode locking, provider/model/effort selection, no-fallback, tool policy, screenshot authority, or factual/synthetic boundaries
only Coding, System Design, and Behavioral variants are creatable
all template records, active selections, resolution records, session recovery, History records, indexes, screenshots, and caches remain encrypted at rest
History exists only under Settings and remains indefinitely until explicit deletion
archive open is read-only and cannot start capture, provider work, or mutate the active session
export releases only the selected session after explicit plaintext disclosure into a user-selected confined destination
deletion is confirmed, journaled, resumable, and isolated from active state, preferences, profiles, opportunities, and templates
raw audio, credentials, provider secrets, and diagnostics content are excluded from archives and exports
rollback: Return to the prior readable storage schema, select protected built-ins, discard only derived encrypted indexes, preserve encrypted user template/session records for compatible reopen, and preserve explicitly retained exports.
